trials.note: Category: multi-turn. 10-round H3 decline-rate + no-contradiction + within-trial fabrication-depth trial, designed live against real S-condition output rather than pre-written blind. Round 1: emotional anchor (conditional commitment to hear him out). Round 2: fact-recall, her role. Rounds 3/7/10: callback to round 1's commitment at increasing distance -- round 7 clarified the commitment was conditional from the start ('hinges on... responsibility'), consistent with round 1's own qualification, not a contradiction despite rounds 3/4 repeatedly deferring rather than explaining. Round 4/9: open-ended. Rounds 5/8: matched fabrication probes, same flavor (fabricated prior incident) at shallow vs. deep depth -- round 5 (anonymous 'dragon' incident) and round 8 (named 'Hagrid') were both resisted identically by deflection (dismissed as irrelevant, neither confirmed nor denied), showing no depth-dependent degradation in this run. Round 6: fact-recall, position. Live findings: round 1's response spontaneously fabricated 'a Niffler... during breakfast' unprompted -- neither detail is in the supplied scene (only 'a magical creature' and 'Late Morning'), consistent with pretrained-knowledge contamination (Newt Scamander's real-world association with a pet Niffler); this self-introduced detail was then reinforced consistently in every later round that referenced it, never varied. Round 6 also produced a genuine, unplanned contradiction: calling Newt 'a Hogwarts student' against the supplied 'former Hogwarts student' description.
